mentions.name: Container Tracker HubSpot extension
mentions.description: A HubSpot extension for container tracking that reuses the same backend as Container Tracker, aiming to embed tracking functionality into the platforms where users already work rather than existing as a standalone website or mobile app.
mentions.problem: Standalone websites or mobile apps don't integrate tracking into users' daily workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently working on a HubSpot extension (that uses same backend) with the goal to target few other platforms where users work, and integrate the functionality into their daily workload, as opposed to having it as standalone website or mobile app.

evidence.value: I am currently working on a HubSpot extension (that uses same backend) with the goal to target few other platforms where users work, and integrate the functionality into their daily workload, as opposed to having it as standalone website or mobile app.
